tax_litigation.opposing_party: First Appellate Authority. Commissioner of Central Tax (Appeals), Bengaluru
tax_litigation.status: Pursuant to the amalgamation of DFPL with the Company, which became effective on 23rd September 2026, the litigation, along with all associated rights, obligations and liabilities, have vested in the Company. Total Demand of Rs. 4.91 crore along with applicable interest and equivalent penalty thereon. Based on merits of the case and the Company’s assessment, the Company believes that the demand is not sustainable and expects a favourable outcome. The matter is not expected to have any material impact on the Company's financial position or operations. The demand has been disclosed as a contingent liability in the Company's Consolidated Financial Statements. The appeal is pending adjudication. Detailed submissions have been filed and the matter is awaiting further proceedings.

timeline.summary: Pitti Engineering received credit rating assignments and affirmations of IND AA-/Stable/IND A1+ from India Ratings for ₹1,542 Cr of bank loan facilities.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹501.09 Cr (+6.9% YoY), net profit ₹26.61 Cr.
Pitti Engineering’s Board, chaired by **Mary Monica Braganza**, recommended ₹2.50 (50%) final dividend per ₹5 equity share for FY2026, pending AGM approval on May 14, 2026.
On May 14, 2026, Pitti Engineering approved a ₹290 Cr capex for a greenfield casting and machined components facility in Telangana.
Pitti Engineering reported FY26 consolidated total income of ₹1,953 Cr and announced a ₹290 Cr greenfield capex to double casting capacity by Q1FY30.
Pitti Engineering rescheduled its Investor Earnings Call from May 15 to May 18, 2026, at 1:00 PM IST to discuss Q4 & FY26 performance with MD & CEO Akshay S. Pitti.
Pitti Engineering announced a ₹290 crore greenfield capex to expand casting capacity to 36,000 MT by Q1FY30.
Pitti Engineering's Q4 & FY26 earnings call on 18 May 2026 guided FY27 revenue to ₹2,300 Cr and detailed a ₹290 Cr greenfield casting capex for Q1FY30 commissioning.

Pitti Engineering issued an addendum on 3 June 2026 to its 14 May 2026 capex notice, adding the machining capacity details: 7,20,000 hours existing at ~81% utilisation, to be raised to 10,80,000 hours.
Pitti Engineering concluded its Maharashtra GST search proceedings, agreeing to discharge ₹0.63 Cr tax and ₹0.15 Cr interest.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹578.44 Cr, net profit ₹33.89 Cr (-4.7% YoY).

Pitti Engineering Limited’s Board, chaired by **Mary Monica Braganza**, declared ₹2.00 (40%) interim dividend per ₹5 equity share on October 22, 2026, payable by November 21, 2026, with record date November 2.
Pitti Engineering's board approved a ₹450 Cr capex to expand sheet metal and machining capacities up to FY31.
Pitti Engineering's Q2FY27 investor presentation showed revenue up 21.1% YoY to ₹578.4 Cr but adjusted PAT down 15.1% to ₹36.3 Cr, with a ~₹740 Cr phased capacity expansion to FY31.
